name: mesh
evidence: Map piece binders `{map}_m.dcx.bnd` ship both. m4000 has 57 full FLVERs and 39 `_l1` (54 of 72 kind-0 parts). No `_l2`. Face-set flags are 0, so the LOD is the other file, not FS_LOD1. The suffix table at 0x82c02498 names `_l1.` (string 0x820f5668); MapPartsLinkModelDataProxy (0x82d0eee0, source string 0x8210c5c0) registers every variant the model lists

name: metric
evidence: 0x82d107f0 reads the model radius at +0x5c, squares it into a vec4 (a sphere test) and stores distance+radius at +8 and distance-radius at +4. 0x82d13e70 returns f1/f2, using 0.1 (0x82013518) as the numerator when f1 is below it. The caller passes f1 = distance-radius and f2 = radius * 2 (2 at 0x820b005c). The distance itself is the VMX length that those two stores add to and subtract from the radius. Stored at the LOD object +0x80

name: level
evidence: 0x82d10640 (vtable 0x8210c7c8 slot +0x68) compares +0x80 with 15 (0x82039608), 2 (0x820b005c), 0.4 (0x82052b18) and 0.1 (0x82013518), high to low. Map pieces have no `_l2` or `_l3`, so levels 1-3 draw `_l1`. Above 15 the function returns 0 before picking a level. Treating that as 'do not draw' hid 481 of 550 m4000 parts at the actest camera (the small objects) and left the ground under the AC, so the runtime keeps the part and uses `_l1` there too. The mesh fetch that follows a chosen level, 0x82d134b0, is `li r3, 0; blr`
